item.title: AI-Powered Promotional Products Website

The centrepiece is the AI agent. When a visitor lands on the site the assistant will chat with them, gather key details, then generate a full recommended order complete with quantities and live pricing. To do that the AI must first prompt for:
• Event or purpose, target audience, and budget • Product type, quantity, and preferred colours • Logo or artwork files, delivery location, and required date
Once the proposal is built the customer can decide how to move forward: request a quote from us, add the items straight to an online cart and check out, or simply save the recommendation and have it emailed to themselves.
I’m happy for you to select the tech stack – React or Vue on the front end, Node, Python or similar on the back, OpenAI or comparable LLM for the assistant – as long as it delivers a fast, mobile-friendly experience, handles secure payments, and lets me manage products, orders, and customer chats from an admin panel.
Please outline: • Your approach to syncing and caching the supplier API • How you will train / prompt the AI to produce accurate, priced recommendations • Milestones for design, AI integration, API connection, testing, and launch
If you have live examples of AI-assisted shopping or complex API-driven catalogues, share them. I’m ready to move quickly once I’m confident you can deliver.

item.title: Oil & Gas Website Redesign
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m ready to overhaul our corporate website so that engineers, procurement teams, and HSE managers can reach the technical information they need in as few clicks as possible. Because our audience is almost entirely energy-sector professionals, I need a designer–developer who already understands the terminology, documentation, and compliance culture of oil and gas.
The existing site buries critical content. In the new build, service details, equipment specs, project case studies with hard numbers, and all safety certificates must sit front and center. Just as important, the layout has to showcase our full range of services and capabilities, underline our track record with recognizable clients, and make our safety culture unmistakable.
My ideal flow looks like this: visitors land on a clean, modern homepage, choose a service or a project type, and immediately see spec sheets, photos, and downloadable PDFs. Past projects should be filterable by region, discipline, and results, while a separate compliance area houses every certificate in an organized repository.
I’m open on platform, but the final site has to be responsive, fast, and easy for our in-house team to update—think WordPress with a solid page-builder or a lightweight headless setup if you can justify it. Whichever route you choose, I’ll need:
• Wireframes that prove the information architecture solves our “hard-to-find” problem • Polished UI designs tailored to an energy-sector brand • Full development and migration of current content, including redirect mapping • Basic analytics and on-page SEO set-up so we can track how well users find specs, case studies, and certificates
Acceptance criteria: every key document or spec should be reachable from the homepage in two clicks or fewer; page load time under three seconds on a 4G connection; CMS hand-over with a short video walkthrough for my team.
If you live and breathe oil and gas projects and can translate that knowledge into a user-centric digital experience, let’s talk.

item.title: ¡En Vivo Contigo!
item.description:
250-750 USD | I want a complete n8n workflow that funnels every website-chat message through two AI agents—Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini—so visitors get instant, accurate answers about their own account, order, or booking.
Here’s how I picture the flow: a webhook catches the chat event, n8n verifies the customer’s identity, pulls the relevant account or order details from our database/CRM, then feeds that context to Claude. If Claude’s confidence score drops below an agreed threshold or a policy rule is triggered, Gemini steps in as either a fallback or a second opinion. The final answer is returned to the chat widget in real time, all within a few seconds.
Key deliverables • Production-ready n8n workflow file (.json) with clear node naming and comments • Secure connectors to our database/CRM (REST or SQL, whichever you choose) that surface only the fields required for support answers • Claude and Gemini prompt templates that inject the retrieved customer data and enforce tone/formatting guidelines • Error-handling, retry, and logging nodes so failed calls are flagged and stored for review • Environment variable setup and a quick-start README so I can import the flow, drop in my API keys, and go live • Demo recording or live walkthrough proving the agent answers typical chat questions—“Where’s my order?”, “What’s the status of booking #1234?”, “Can I change my delivery address?”—with no manual intervention
Acceptance criteria 1. A visitor receives a correct, personalised reply in under 5 seconds. 2. Sensitive data never appears in logs or model prompts unless explicitly required for the answer. 3. Switching model order (Gemini first, Claude fallback) is a one-line change in the workflow.
If you’ve built multi-model automations in n8n before—or have clever ideas on prompt engineering, vector stores, or function calling to sharpen responses—I’m all ears. Let’s ship this fast.

item.title: Campaign Website Content Manager
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need a reliable web-content professional to keep our official government campaign site up to date. The site is strictly a platform for publishing our news and policy promises, so the focus is on timely, accurate posting rather than content creation.
Here’s how the workflow will go: my campaign team will email you finished news articles and press releases. Your task is to log in to the site’s WordPress CMS, format each piece so it matches our style guide, add the correct categories, meta descriptions, alt text and tags, then publish or schedule it at the agreed time. Light image resizing or thumbnail generation may be needed now and then, but no copy-writing or rewriting.
Typical volume is two to four posts a week, with occasional bursts around major announcements. I expect quick turnarounds—ideally within 12 hours of receiving the material—and spotless presentation that looks good on desktop and mobile alike.
Deliverables I will review: • Every supplied article/press release published on the correct URL, fully formatted, with working hyperlinks. • SEO fields completed (Yoast or similar) and accessibility attributes in place. • Post live or scheduled within the agreed window. • A brief weekly report listing all updates and any technical issues flagged.
Please be comfortable working in WordPress, basic HTML/CSS tweaks, image optimisation and simple on-page SEO. If you can start right away and keep the cadence going through election day, let’s talk.

item.title: Government Campaign Site Management
item.description:

You’ll also maintain the interactive pieces that matter most to citizens: registration forms for updates or events, feedback and inquiry forms that route to the right departments, and a clean download area for campaign materials or official PDFs.
I’m comfortable with a mainstream CMS such as WordPress or Drupal—anything that lets us publish quickly, manage user data responsibly, and plug in analytics and mass-mail tools without headaches. If you can recommend an even better stack for government-grade reliability, say so; I’m open.
Key deliverables • Stable, easy-to-update website hosted on a reputable platform • Content publishing setup for news, events, and document libraries • Action-driven forms tied to an email list or CRM of your choice • Ongoing monitoring, backups, and security patches • Monthly performance report highlighting sign-ups, feedback volume, and downloads
Acceptance criteria • Pages load in under 2 seconds for 95 % of users • All forms deliver data accurately to our database and trigger email confirmations • Site passes WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility checks and routine security scans

item.title: Launch Island Microgreens Online Presence
item.description:
250-750 AUD | Island Microgreens – Facebook, Instagram & Weekly Order Website We need a freelancer to set up our social media presence and a simple weekly ordering website for Island Microgreens. We grow fresh microgreens on Macleay Island and deliver weekly to households across the Redlands (Cleveland, Victoria Point, Redland Bay, Thornlands, Mount Cotton and surrounding areas).
1. Facebook Business Page • Clean, fresh, natural look that reflects local produce and Macleay Island. • Profile photos should work well with green/fresh produce imagery. • Must-haves: clear call-to-action for weekly orders, local Redlands focus, easy-to-find ordering information, and a consistent brand voice that is friendly and practical (not overly corporate). • Content plans should prioritise harvest photos, simple use ideas (e.g. on avocado toast or salads), order reminders, and behind-the-scenes of the growing room.
2. Instagram Business Profile • Clean, fresh, natural look that reflects local produce and Macleay Island. • Profile photos should work well with green/fresh produce imagery. • Must-haves: clear call-to-action for weekly orders, local Redlands focus, easy-to-find ordering information, and a consistent brand voice that is friendly and practical (not overly corporate). • Content plans should prioritise harvest photos, simple use ideas (e.g. on avocado toast or salads), order reminders, and behind-the-scenes of the growing room.
3. Simple Weekly Order Website • Simple, clean, mobile-first design. Easy to use on a phone. • Preference for a fresh, natural aesthetic (greens, whites, light backgrounds) that suits a small local food producer. • Must-have features: ◦ Clear product display for the weekly household pack and optional single varieties ◦ Straightforward order form with name, phone, delivery address, quantity and notes ◦ Prominent order cut-off information (Monday 5 pm) ◦ Automatic order notifications (email or Google Sheet) ◦ Easy for a non-technical person to update prices and descriptions later ◦ Fast loading and basic local SEO No complex features are needed — the priority is a reliable weekly pre-order system that is simple for both customers and us to use. Happy for freelancers to suggest their recommended approach within this scope. Timeline: 3–5 weeks Out of scope: Paid ads, ongoing posting after handover, professional photography, complex subscriptions Please include relevant examples (food, farm or local product businesses) and quote a fixed price for all three together.

item.title: Secure WooCommerce Upgrade & UX Refresh
item.description:

We’re looking for an experienced WordPress/WooCommerce developer to help maintain, secure, and improve our existing e-commerce website.
Website: https://beautykitchen.net
Our main priority is upgrading the PHP environment, addressing potential security vulnerabilities, and ensuring the website runs smoothly. We’d also like to make some minor UI/UX improvements to give the site a cleaner, more modern look and improve the overall shopping experience.
Scope of Work
1. PHP Upgrade & Security
• Review the current PHP version and upgrade to a supported, secure version.. • Identify and address known PHP security vulnerabilities.. • Update WordPress, WooCommerce, themes, and plugins where necessary.. • Resolve any compatibility issues caused by the upgrades.. • Review basic server security and configuration..
2. UI/UX Improvements
• Make minor improvements to the website’s existing design.. • Refine product page layouts, buttons, typography, and spacing.. • Improve mobile responsiveness and navigation.. • Fix visual inconsistencies and minor frontend issues.. • Maintain the existing branding and overall design style..
3. Testing & Stability
• Ensure all existing website functionality works correctly after the updates.. • Test product pages, shopping cart, checkout, and payment integrations.. • Identify and fix any errors introduced during the upgrade.. • Create a backup before making changes and ensure a rollback option is available.. • Provide a brief summary of completed updates and any remaining recommendations..
Requirements
• Strong experience with PHP, WordPress, and WooCommerce.. • Hands-on experience with PHP version upgrades and security patching.. • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web design.. • Ability to troubleshoot plugin and theme compatibility issues.. • Familiarity with website hosting, server configurations, and performance optimization.. • Good communication skills and attention to detail.. • Ability to work on an existing website without unnecessary changes or disruptions..
Potential for Long-Term Collaboration
If we’re satisfied with the quality of the initial work, we’d be happy to continue working with the same developer on future projects, including:
• Website performance optimization and speed improvements.. • New features and functionality.. • AI-powered features and automation.. • Third-party API integrations.. • Ongoing website maintenance and technical improvements..
We’re ideally looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term development partner as our website continues to grow.
When Applying
Please include:
• A brief introduction and your relevant WordPress/WooCommerce experience.. • Examples of similar PHP upgrade, security, or frontend improvement projects.. • Your estimated timeline and fixed-price quote for the initial scope.. • Your availability for potential ongoing work..
We’re looking for someone who can deliver clean, reliable work while keeping our existing store stable and fully functional.
